SPLC.description: Response Spectrum Load Case (SPLC). A spectrum load case referencing one or more spectrum functions (aFUNCNAME); optional blocks are gated by check-box flags: bMODE enables per-mode participation (aUSEMODE), bDAMP enables the damping method selected by iMDTYPE, and bACCECC enables accidental eccentricity.

DIR.description: Excitation direction. Case-insensitive. XY = horizontal (X-Y plane), Z = vertical.

SCALE.description: Scale factor applied to the spectrum.

bDAMP.description: Apply damping method check-box. When true, the damping fields (bCDAMP, iMDTYPE and the iMDTYPE-dependent fields) are used.

INTERP.description: Interpolation of spectral data. Case-insensitive. LINEAR = linear, LOG = logarithmic.

COMTYPE.description: Modal combination type. Case-insensitive. SRSS, CQC, ABS, or Linear.

bADDSIGN.description: Add signs to the results check-box.

iSIGNTYPE.description: Add-signs-to-results type. 0 = along the major mode direction, 1 = along the absolute maximum value.

bMODE.description: Select mode shapes check-box. When true, aUSEMODE must be supplied and non-empty.

bAUTO.description: Auto search excitation angle check-box. When true, iAUTOTYPE is used.

bNDP.description: [when a referenced spectrum function supports non-dissipative design] Non-dissipative element design flag.

NDP.description: [when a referenced spectrum function supports non-dissipative design] Non-dissipative value.

aFUNCNAME.description: List of spectrum function names to apply. Each name must already exist as a spectrum function.

aUSEMODE.description: [bMODE=true] Per-mode participation list; one object per eigen mode.

MSFACTOR.description: Mode shape (participation) factor for this mode.

iMDTYPE.description: [bDAMP=true] Damping ratio method type. 1 = direct specification of damping ratio (uses DALL, aDAMPING), 2 = mass & stiffness proportional (uses iCOEF, bMASSP, bSTIFFP and either MASSC/STIFFC or iCALC/FP1/FP2/DR1/DR2), 3 = group (element/material group damping).

DALL.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=1] Damping ratio applied to all modes.

aDAMPING.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=1] Modal damping overrides, one object per overridden mode.

iCOEF.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2] Coefficient definition method. 1 = direct coefficient specification (uses MASSC/STIFFC), other = calculated from frequency/period (uses iCALC, FP1/FP2, DR1/DR2).

MASSC.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF=1, bMASSP=true] Mass proportional coefficient.

STIFFC.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF=1, bSTIFFP=true] Stiffness proportional coefficient.

iCALC.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF!=1] Coefficient calculation basis. 1 = frequency, 2 = period.

FP1.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF!=1] Frequency or period value for mode 1.

FP2.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF!=1] Frequency or period value for mode 2.

DR1.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF!=1] Damping ratio for mode 1.

DR2.description: [bDAMP=true, iMDTYPE=2, iCOEF!=1] Damping ratio for mode 2.

bACCECC.description: Accidental eccentricity check-box. When true, the eccentricity fields are used.

bACCECC_AUTO.description: [bACCECC=true] Eccentricity data mode. true = automatic (uses ACCECC_PERCENT), false = user-defined list (uses aACCECC_ECCEN_LIST).

ACCECC_PERCENT.description: [bACCECC=true, bACCECC_AUTO=true] Accidental eccentricity as a percentage.

aACCECC_ECCEN_LIST.description: [bACCECC=true, bACCECC_AUTO=false] User-defined per-story accidental eccentricity list.
